name: L_ATOM_SEMANTIC_DEEP_DIVE
description: 15-round hypothesis-test investigation of atom l's semantic function, using crazy-expert agent to propose hypotheses and quantitative scripts to test them. Established l = 'state/condition marker' at SOLID confidence, upgrading from WEAK ('frame'). Discovered ACTOR/RESPONDER terminal-atom timing split as independent structural finding.
source: Crazy-expert agent iterative hypothesis generation + quantitative validation

P-L1.name: l-initial MIDDLEs enriched in REGIME_2 (collection)
P-L1.prediction: l-initial enriched in REGIME_2 vs REGIME_1
P-L1.reason: Directionally correct but not significant. l-initial is too rare overall for regime-level detection.

P-L2.name: l-atom tokens have elevated FL_SAFE rates
P-L2.prediction: l-bearing MIDDLEs enriched in FL_SAFE macro-state
P-L2.reason: l is NOT enriched in FL_SAFE. Instead slightly enriched in AXM (1.069x). l-terminal specifically shows strongest AXM enrichment. 'Let flow' falsified.

P-L3.name: l-bearing MIDDLEs enriched in TRANSITION category
P-L3.prediction: l-atom MIDDLEs enriched in TRANSITION category (C1250)
P-L3.reason: l is DEPLETED in TRANSITION (0.61x). Instead massively enriched in STAGING (9.7x). l-terminal position shows STAGING at 28.3% vs 3.3% baseline. 'Release/discharge' falsified. STAGING signal is the key finding.

P-L4.name: l-atom tokens front-load within paragraphs
P-L4.prediction: l-atom enriched in paragraph Q0 (first 20%) at >= 1.5x vs Q4
P-L4.reason: Dead flat. l has no paragraph-positional gradient. 'Arrange/lay' falsified at paragraph level.

P-L5.name: l-atom fraction correlates with THERMAL line fraction
P-L5.reason: l anticorrelates with THERMAL (-0.078). Strongest positive is STAGING (+0.299). At line level, l anticorrelates with k (-0.184) despite folio-level positive cluster (Simpson's paradox). 'Level' falsified.

P-L6.name: l-terminal compounds show universal STAGING additive shift
P-L6.prediction: l-terminal STAGING enriched across >=3 initial-atom groups

details.note: l-terminal always redirects to a DIFFERENT category than base atom's default

P-L6.reason: STAGING shift confirmed but the pattern is REDIRECTION not ADDITION. l doesn't add staging to the base — it replaces the base's default category entirely. This is stronger than predicted.

P-L7.name: l-terminal compounds have highest categorical purity (HHI)
P-L7.prediction: l-terminal HHI highest of all terminal atoms
P-L7.reason: l-terminal is one of the LEAST categorically pure terminal atoms. 'Specifier' falsified.

P-L8.name: l-terminal MIDDLE fraction predicts LOW AXM self-transition
P-L8.prediction: Negative rho for l-terminal fraction vs AXM self-transition
P-L8.reason: Direction INVERTED vs prediction but finding is important: l is pro-AXM (+0.299), ranking 3rd after k (+0.620) and t (+0.318). l operates WITHIN the main loop, not as an exit. 'Redirect' falsified.

P-L9.name: l-terminal MIDDLEs predict LOW macro-state transition rate

details.note: ol (most common l-terminal) INCREASES transitions; other l-terminals weakly decrease them

P-L9.reason: Split result: ol diverges from other l-terminals. The ol compound has a different functional signature. 'Continue/sustain' partially falsified.

P-L10.name: l-terminal MIDDLEs have higher suffix mode flexibility
P-L10.prediction: l-terminal closer to 50/50 Mode A/B than non-l-terminal

details.note: l is Mode B LOCKED. Only pro-AXM terminal that is also Mode B.

P-L10.reason: l is one of the LEAST flexible atoms for mode. Mode B locking means l appears overwhelmingly in continuation/bare lines. 'Nominalizer' falsified. But Mode B locking later supports 'state' — states are observed (Mode B), not specified (Mode A).

P-L11.name: l-terminal lines have lower kernel contact
P-L11.reason: Just missed 0.85x threshold (0.870x) but correlation is HIGHLY significant. h most avoided (0.744x). Holds in all sections. Best result up to this point.

P-L12.name: l-terminal tokens in longer same-state runs (extended dwell)
P-L12.reason: Completely inverted: l is in SHORTER runs (0.739x) and predicts state CHANGES. l is at state BOUNDARIES, not in stable dwell. 'Hold/standby' definitively falsified.

P-L13.name: l-terminal has HIGH successor MIDDLE diversity
P-L13.prediction: l-terminal successor entropy in TOP 3, above e,k,h
P-L13.reason: l has CONSTRAINED/predictable successors, not open-ended. After a state reading, the next step is predictable. 'Free/available' falsified.

P-L14.name: X-atom precedes Xl-compound on shared lines
P-L14.prediction: X precedes Xl at >60% on shared lines
P-L14.reason: Some base atoms show X-before-Xl, but the control test is devastating: l is NOT special for ordering. el appears EARLIER than e-non-l (opposite of product). 'Product/deposit' falsified by control.

P-L15.name: l-terminal is state/condition marker (4 sub-tests)
P-L15.reason: STRONGEST RESULT IN ALL 15 ROUNDS. Three of four tests confirm: l avoids driving lines (7.42% opener vs 9.75%), l appears after state changes at 68.9% (vs 47.2% baseline — MASSIVE), kernel precedes l 77% of the time. Discovered ACTOR/RESPONDER timing split as independent structural finding.

key_evidence: Mode B locked (72%) -- status readings not specifications
Category redirection (0/5 match base atom default)
